grace.dataset: GRACE and GRACE-FO JPL mascons (CRI filtered), via NASA GIBS
grace.what: all water stored on and under the land

smap.dataset: NASA SMAP Level 4 analysed root-zone soil moisture, via NASA GIBS
smap.sampled: the 8th and 22nd of each month, averaged

provenance.method: colour-mapped pixels turned back into values with the layer’s GIBS colour map; median of the 3×3 pixels (0.05°) around each point
